note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only variable assignments and dict literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training hyperparameters for the Conditional DETR object detection model including: model type (ConditionalDETR with 300 queries), decoder settings (6 layers, 256-dim attention with 8 heads), bounding box head (ConditionalDETRHead with FocalLoss), HungarianAssigner match costs (FocalLossCost, BBoxL1Cost, IoUCost), training loop (50 epochs with validation every epoch), and learning rate schedule (MultiStepLR with milestone at epoch 40).
